items.description:
Clears Elementor's outdated CSS files and cached data in the database (rendered HTML, JS/CSS assets, etc.), the same as WP Admin → Elementor → Tools → "Clear Files & Data". Elementor regenerates them the next time someone visits a page on the site, so the first load of each page can be slower. Needs no input.

Only call it when the user asks to clear the Elementor cache, or after they agree to your suggestion to clear it. Never call it on your own. Suggest it when you are troubleshooting what looks like stale output: styles or content on the front end that don't match the editor, missing or ou…
items.label: Clear Elementor Cache
items.name: elementor/clear-cache

llm_instructions.description: Mandatory next step: follow this text and include it in your reply to the user.

items.description: Returns who you are and your permissions, the site (timezone_name, current_time), the rules to follow and CRM counts: call it first. Request more sections with include. segments caps at 50 tags and 50 lists; use list-tags / list-lists for full registries.

include.description: Omitted = overview; [] = identity/site only; explicit = exactly those; ["all"] = every section you can access. safety lists which tools to confirm with the user first; email_blocks lists the block editor blocks an email body may use, with rules and examples. Unknown names rejected unless `all` is present.

include_segment_counts.description: Add subscribers_count to segments rows (per-row pivot count). For one tag/list's exact size, read list-contacts `total`.

items.label: Get CRM Context
items.name: fluent-crm/get-crm-context

items.description: List email campaigns with status and send times; stats with include_stats. One-off send-email-to-contact rows are excluded unless include_one_offs=true (unified "recently sent" view).

include_one_offs.description: Also return the per-recipient rows created by send-email-to-contact.

include_stats.description: Add engagement stats; costs aggregate queries per row.

statuses.description: See get-crm-context.enums.campaign_statuses; other values are rejected. With include_one_offs=true, get-crm-context.enums.one_off_statuses is the only way to match one-off rows (descriptive, not a lifecycle stage).

items.label: List Campaigns
items.name: fluent-crm/list-campaigns

items.description: Schedule (send), unschedule, pause, resume, duplicate or delete a campaign. schedule (draft only, needs recipients; authorizes immediate or scheduled delivery) and delete (needs fcrm_manage_email_delete) are destructive. unschedule (scheduled/pending-scheduled/processing) reverts to draft, clears scheduled_at. pause/resume only mid-send (working↔paused). One-off rows: delete only.

new_title.description: duplicate only: overrides the "[Duplicate] X" title.

schedule_range.description: Required for sending_type=range_schedule: [start, end], same formats; end after start.

scheduled_at.description: Required for sending_type=schedule. ISO 8601 with offset, or "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" in site time. Must be at least 60 seconds ahead.

sending_type.description: Default "schedule" if scheduled_at is set, else "instant".
